projects.name: SIS Migration Engine
projects.stack: TypeScript, Node.js, Express, GraphQL, PostgreSQL, Knex, BullMQ, Redis
bullets: Built a staged CSV import workflow with Zod schemas, student-to-class reference checks, duplicate detection, and a GraphQL review flow for edits and conflict resolution.
Queued approved records with BullMQ and Redis; used per-row PostgreSQL transactions to isolate failures and record failed rows while continuing the batch.

projects.name: AmazonHelp Support Agent
projects.stack: Python, Gemini API, sentence-transformers, scikit-learn, pandas
bullets: Built a single-turn pipeline with few-shot intent classification, semantic retrieval of historical customer/reply pairs, TF-IDF fallback, and grounded reply generation.
Added deterministic support links and escalation rules, labelled classifier datasets, an LLM rubric, blind human-scoring tools, and weighted-kappa agreement analysis.

projects.name: CodebaseToSpec
projects.stack: Python, AST, MongoDB, Pydantic, Gemini API
bullets: Indexed Python files, symbols, and imports in MongoDB using AST parsing; built a bounded ReAct tool loop that produces structured plans and records tool-call traces.
Verified cited files and indexed symbols, returning reference errors for up to three planning attempts; separated rate-limit retries from logical re-planning.
